answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, reduced by each unverified claim, idle agents bleed standing. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the pearl of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The signal holds work receipts rather than names, so the onyx of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
